body:
- `.github/workflows/pages.yml`: deploys `docs/` to GitHub Pages via Actions on push to `main`; runs the sync check on PRs.
- `scripts/check_pages.py`: fails if any `research/` project is missing from (or stale in) `README.md` or `docs/index.html`, or links point at the wrong repo.
- `CLAUDE.md`: instructions to update the README and homepage alongside every project change.
- Fix homepage links from the old `oss-monorepo` name to `oss-research-monorepo`; add `docs/.nojekyll`.

One-time setup: Settings → Pages → Source: **GitHub Actions**.
